label: Action - Modern Blockbuster
summary: Kinetic, contrasty, teal-and-orange spectacle: the camera is inside the fight, close and moving.

craft.lighting: Hard backlight cutting through haze, motivated colour (sodium, neon, fire) against teal ambience; deep clean blacks.
craft.camera_movement: Shoulder-mounted handheld or gimbal riding with the actors; whip pans between beats; vehicle and crane rigs for chases.
craft.framing: Short lenses close in on bodies for impact; low angles on the hero; foreground debris and obstructions add depth.
shot_tips: Cover each fight beat in a wide master plus two tight angles, then cut on impact, never mid-swing
Use a fast shutter (45 to 90 degrees) for crisp, staccato debris and sparks
Keep screen direction locked so geography survives fast cutting
Punch in with a 24 mm close to the face for hits; go wide for the payoff

notes: Shutter angle has no vocab id; carried in craft tips. 'raw_chaos' is the closest technique to energetic combat handheld.

label: Action - Gritty Desaturated
summary: Bleached, sweaty, documentary-style combat: shaky, close and claustrophobic, colour drained to steel.

craft.lighting: Available and practical light, hard overhead fluorescents, little fill; let highlights clip.
craft.camera_movement: Shoulder handheld with snap zooms and searching reframes, as if a camera operator is chasing the action.
craft.framing: Tight, partially obstructed frames; the edge of a shoulder or door frame in foreground; long lens from across streets.
shot_tips: Shoot the fight with two handheld cameras at once and cut on the hit
Let the operator find the action late, a beat behind, for realism
Use doorways and crowds to hide cuts and stunt doubles

notes: Subgenre 'action.spy' chosen for the Bourne lineage; swap to action.practical for non-espionage stories.

label: Action - Hong Kong / Martial Arts
summary: Balletic, full-body choreography in smoke and neon, wide enough to see every move, fast enough to feel each blow.

craft.lighting: Hard backlight blasting through smoke, neon blue and red at night, warm tungsten interiors, muzzle flash as key.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly locked or dolly-mounted for the choreography; crash zooms, undercranking for speed, slow motion for the hero beat.
craft.framing: Full-body wides so the choreography reads; long-lens singles for the stare-down; doves and debris in foreground.
shot_tips: Frame the whole body and the whole move; the fight is the performance
Undercrank slightly (20-22 fps) to sharpen strikes, and repeat a big impact from two or three angles
Hold for a beat of stillness between exchanges, then explode
Use slow motion for one emotional moment per sequence, not every hit

notes: Kodak 500T postdates the era (period stocks were Eastmancolor/Fuji); it stands in for fast tungsten night stock.

label: Western - Classic
summary: Monument-Valley grandeur: deep-focus vistas, saturated skies, small figures in a mythic landscape.

craft.lighting: Natural daylight, hard sun with bounce fill; dark interiors framed against a bright doorway.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly static on sticks; slow pans following riders; camera car for chases.
craft.framing: Low horizon, big sky; figures placed small against the land; doorway frames-within-frames.
shot_tips: Put the horizon low and let the sky take two-thirds of the frame
Stage riders crossing the frame laterally against a landmark
Frame the hero through a dark doorway looking out to the light

notes: Cooke S4 stands in for period Cooke Speed Panchro / Baltar primes.

label: Western - Spaghetti
summary: Sun-bleached ritual violence: extreme wides cut against extreme close-ups of sweating eyes.

craft.lighting: Hard noon sun, deep shadow under hat brims, dusty interior shafts.
craft.camera_movement: Locked-off tableaux; slow push or crash zoom into eyes; occasional crane reveal.
craft.framing: Extreme wide landscapes with a face in the foreground corner, then extreme close-ups of eyes, hands and holsters.
shot_tips: Alternate an extreme wide with an extreme close-up, no medium shots, as the duel tightens
Lengthen each cut as the standoff builds, cut to the music, not the action
Put a face huge in the foreground with the antagonist small in the background
Hold silence before the draw; the gunshot is a single fast cut

references: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
Once Upon a Time in the West
notes: Leone shot Techniscope (2-perf spherical widescreen), not true anamorphic; 'anamorphic' approximates the 2.35 frame.

label: Film Noir
summary: Black-and-white fatalism: hard single-source light, venetian-blind shadows, wet streets and cigarette smoke.

craft.lighting: Low-key chiaroscuro, one hard source, gobos and venetian blinds, glamour key with edge light on the femme fatale.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly static with slow dolly moves; occasional crane down into the street.
craft.framing: Low angles with ceilings in frame, deep-focus wide lenses, dutch tilts when the world goes wrong.
shot_tips: Light the set, not the actor: let faces fall into shadow
Wet the streets and add haze so the single source has something to cut through
Shoot from low with a wide lens so ceilings press down on the characters

notes: Cooke S4 stands in for period Baltar / Speed Panchro primes.

label: Neo-Noir
summary: Noir in colour: sodium streetlight, neon reflections on wet asphalt, a lonely figure in deep saturated shadow.

craft.lighting: Low key with neon and sodium practicals, hard backlight in haze, wet ground reflecting colour.
craft.camera_movement: Slow glides and car-mount travelling shots; patient static frames; rare handheld bursts for violence.
craft.framing: Isolated figures in wide frames, long-lens observation through glass and windshields.
shot_tips: Wet down every street and let practicals do the lighting
Shoot through windshields and windows to keep the audience watching from outside
Hold the frame after the character leaves it

label: Horror - Supernatural
summary: Cold, still, patient dread: wide frames with too much empty space and darkness that might be hiding something.

craft.lighting: Low key, cold moonlight against sickly tungsten pools, single motivated sources; let blacks crush.
craft.camera_movement: Locked-off or glacial dolly; slow pans that reveal; steadicam drifts down corridors.
craft.framing: Wide lenses with negative space beside the character; dark doorways deep in frame.
shot_tips: Leave empty space in the frame and make the audience search it
Hold the shot longer than is comfortable before anything happens
Pan away and back to reveal a change, instead of cutting

label: Horror - Slasher (70s-80s)
summary: Grainy suburban nightmare: blue moonlight, a gliding POV that stalks, and a killer framed deep in the background.

craft.lighting: Hard blue 'moonlight' backlight, warm interior windows, red accent for blood; deep crushed shadows.
craft.camera_movement: Prowling Steadicam POV from the killer, slow push-ins on victims, static frames that let the killer appear deep in focus.
craft.framing: Wide widescreen frames with the victim in the foreground and the threat small and soft behind them.
shot_tips: Stage the killer deep in the background while the victim stays unaware in the foreground
Use a first-person prowling shot to put the audience in the killer's shoes
Save the red: keep the palette blue until the first kill

notes: Kodak 500T postdates the era; it stands in for 1970s-80s fast tungsten stock. 'fear' used as mood (no 'terror' id).

label: Romantic Comedy
summary: Warm, bright and safe: golden light, city glow and two-shots whose gap closes as the leads fall in love.

craft.lighting: High key, golden-hour exteriors, soft backlight on hair, warm practicals in apartments.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly static for banter; slow push-in on the realisation; an orbit for the reunion.
craft.framing: Balanced 50/50 two-shots with space between the leads; matched singles; lenses lengthen as feelings grow.
shot_tips: Keep the banter in a stable medium two-shot and cut on the line
Start with wide lenses and a gap between the leads, then move to longer lenses as they get closer
Give the realisation a slow dolly-in on the face

label: Romance / Melodrama
summary: Lush, aching, saturated longing: soft glowing light, rich colour and faces that fill the frame.

craft.lighting: Soft wrap key, warm practicals, rain-streaked windows and backlit hair; diffusion blooms the highlights.
craft.camera_movement: Slow dolly and crane moves that swell with the score; holds on faces.
craft.framing: Close-ups on longer lenses, shallow focus isolating the lovers; frames within frames (windows, mirrors) for separation.
shot_tips: Shoot the key emotional beats in close-up on an 85 mm or longer
Use window and mirror frames to show what keeps the lovers apart
Let colour carry emotion: a saturated accent (red coat, green dress) per character

notes: Soft_diffusion (Pro-Mist) chosen as lens to get the glow; pair with cooke_s4 if diffusion is too strong.

label: Drama - Naturalistic Indie
summary: Unvarnished intimacy: available light, handheld close to faces, muted real-world colour.

craft.lighting: Motivated by windows and practicals, minimal fill, let the light be imperfect.
craft.camera_movement: Handheld that breathes with the actors; long takes; reframes rather than cuts.
craft.framing: Medium close-ups at eye level; tight over-shoulders; leave room for awkward silence.
shot_tips: Light the location, not the shot, so actors can move freely
Let the take run and find moments between the lines
Keep the camera at eye level and close; no showy angles

notes: Movement 'american_indie_90s' is the nearest lineage; set movement to 'auto' for a present-day feel.

label: Thriller / Suspense
summary: Controlled, precise, cold tension: every frame composed, every move deliberate, information withheld.

craft.lighting: Low key, desaturated with sickly yellow-green practicals, hard top light, shadows that hide eyes.
craft.camera_movement: Locked or perfectly smooth dolly and slider moves; no wobble; slow creeping push-ins.
craft.framing: Centred, symmetrical frames; inserts on the threatening object; long lens surveillance shots.
shot_tips: Show the audience the threat the character cannot see, then hold
Move the camera only when the story turns, and move it slowly
Cut to an insert of the key object to plant it before it matters

notes: Sodium_decay approximates Fincher's yellow-green; cold_steel is the cooler alternative.

label: Sci-fi - Sleek Future
summary: Clean, monumental, near-monochrome future: vast architecture, haze and one bold accent colour.

craft.lighting: Large soft single sources, silhouette backlight, haze to lift the blacks; one accent colour at most.
craft.camera_movement: Slow, stately dollies and crane moves; drones for scale; no handheld.
craft.framing: Symmetrical one-point frames, tiny figures against massive structures, clean negative space.
shot_tips: Make the architecture the subject: figures small, structures huge
Choose one accent colour for the whole film and protect it
Move the camera slowly, as if it weighs tonnes

notes: Ice_white chosen for clean future; swap to golden_amber for 2049-style orange haze.

label: Sci-fi - Gritty / Cyberpunk
summary: Rain-soaked neon megacity: magenta and cyan light, smoke, crowds and grime in deep black.

craft.lighting: Hard backlight through smoke and rain, neon and screen practicals as key, shafts from searchlights.
craft.camera_movement: Slow tracking through crowded streets; handheld for violence; overhead vehicle passes.
craft.framing: Layered foregrounds of signage and rain; faces lit by screens; low angles up at towers.
shot_tips: Fill the air with rain and smoke so every light becomes a beam
Light faces with screens and signs, not film lamps
Stack depth: foreground signage, mid-ground character, background towers

notes: The Matrix leans on matrix_green; swap the palette for that variant.

label: Fantasy / Epic
summary: Mythic, painterly grandeur: sweeping landscapes, golden light and heroic low angles.

craft.lighting: Golden-hour and magic-hour sun, firelight interiors, god rays through haze and forest canopy.
craft.camera_movement: Helicopter and crane sweeps over landscapes; slow push-ins on heroes; steadicam through crowds.
craft.framing: Tiny figures in immense landscapes, then heroic low-angle mediums; forced-perspective scale play.
shot_tips: Open each new world with an aerial or crane establishing shot
Shoot heroes from slightly low, villains from slightly high
Use haze and backlight to separate layers of the landscape

references: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
notes: Game of Thrones is a series; included as the reference for TV-scale fantasy.

label: War
summary: Desaturated, grainy chaos at soldier height: the camera is under fire too.

craft.lighting: Flat overcast daylight or harsh sun, smoke and dust, fire and flares at night.
craft.camera_movement: Shoulder handheld at soldier height; shaker or narrow shutter during combat; long tracking oners through trenches.
craft.framing: Eye-level among the troops, debris crossing lens; long lens for distant enemy; huge wides of the aftermath.
shot_tips: Keep the camera at soldier height and never above the parapet until it is safe
Use a narrow shutter (45 degrees) for staccato explosions and dirt
Let the audience lose geography briefly in combat, then restore it with a wide

notes: Set subgenre to war.vietnam / war.trench / war.modern per setting.

label: Documentary / Verite
summary: Caught, not staged: available light, handheld zooms and the slight imperfection of real life.

craft.lighting: Whatever is there: window light, overheads, street light; no added fixtures.
craft.camera_movement: Shoulder-mounted with zoom reframes; follow subjects; slow to react, never ahead of the action.
craft.framing: Off-centre caught moments, partial obstruction, long lens from across the room.
shot_tips: Zoom rather than cut to find the detail mid-take
Stay a beat late: framing that follows the action feels real
Never light the subject; move them to the window instead

notes: For modern digital doc swap camera to modern_digital and stock to arri_log_look.

label: Comedy - Bright & Broad
summary: Bright, flat and readable: even high-key light, saturated sets and frames wide enough for the gag.

craft.lighting: High key, soft and even, low contrast so every face reads.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly static; whip pans and quick push-ins for punchlines.
craft.framing: Medium-wide two- and three-shots so physical comedy plays in one frame; centred reaction close-ups.
shot_tips: Play the gag in a wide that holds both the setup and the payoff
Hold on the reaction; the laugh is often in the face that watches
Avoid shallow focus: the joke can be anywhere in the frame

notes: Subgenre 'comedy.slapstick' best matches broad; use comedy.sitcom for multicam staging.

label: Musical
summary: Saturated, choreographed joy: the camera dances, light shifts with the song, colour is primary and bold.

craft.lighting: Theatrical light cues: a spotlight isolating the singer, colour washes that change with the music, magic-hour exteriors.
craft.camera_movement: Long crane and steadicam oners that move with the choreography; rising cranes for the finale.
craft.framing: Full-figure wides to show the dance; push in to the singer for the emotional verse.
shot_tips: Shoot dance numbers in long takes framed head-to-toe
Let the lighting change on the musical cue, as on a stage
Plan camera moves to the song's bars, like choreography

label: Coming-of-Age / Teen
summary: Golden, nostalgic and a little hazy: summer light, lens flares and the warmth of memory.

craft.lighting: Magic-hour backlight with flare, sunlit bedrooms, neon and car headlights at night.
craft.camera_movement: Handheld and steadicam following the kids; bike and car tracking shots; slow motion for key memories.
craft.framing: Eye level with the teens; group wides; tight close-ups when someone is alone in a crowd.
shot_tips: Schedule big scenes for golden hour and shoot into the sun
Keep the camera at the characters' height, never adult eye-level looking down
Use slow motion sparingly for the moment they will remember forever

label: French New Wave
summary: Spontaneous, grainy street cinema: handheld on real streets, jump cuts, playful freedom.

craft.lighting: Available daylight and practicals; fast stock pushed for night streets.
craft.camera_movement: Handheld on the street, wheelchair and car dollies, long walking-and-talking takes.
craft.framing: Loose, off-centre, characters glancing at camera; real passers-by in frame.
shot_tips: Shoot on real streets with real passers-by
Use jump cuts inside a scene to compress time and add energy
Let actors break the fourth wall with a look to camera

notes: Ilford HP5 stands in for Ilford HPS / Kodak 4-X pushed stock. For the later colour films use technicolor_ib + technicolor_primary.

label: Italian Neorealism
summary: Grey, dusty, unglamorous truth: non-actors on ruined real streets in flat daylight.

craft.lighting: Available daylight, flat overcast; little or no fill; grey mid-tones.
craft.camera_movement: Mostly static or simple truck moves following characters through the city.
craft.framing: Eye-level medium shots that keep the environment and crowd around the characters.
shot_tips: Cast non-actors and shoot in real locations, never sets
Frame wide enough to show the social world around the person
Avoid glamour lighting; let faces be ordinary

label: German Expressionism
summary: Distorted nightmare stage: painted shadows, slanted sets and extreme chiaroscuro.

craft.lighting: Extreme hard low side light, shadows thrown huge on walls, painted highlights on sets.
craft.camera_movement: Locked-off tableaux; the actors and shadows move, not the camera.
craft.framing: Frontal theatrical framing, tilted architecture, the cast shadow as a character.
shot_tips: Let a shadow on the wall enter before the character does
Build the set at angles: no true verticals
Under-light faces from below for menace

notes: Silent-era tints (amber/blue) approximated with sepia_noir palette; swap to classic_bw for pure monochrome.

label: Dogme 95 / Handheld Realism
summary: Raw, ugly-on-purpose video truth: handheld only, available light only, nothing prettified.

craft.lighting: Available light only; mixed colour temperatures left uncorrected; blown windows and muddy shadows.
craft.camera_movement: Handheld always, nervous and searching; jump cuts across the line.
craft.framing: Imperfect, chopped framing; crossing the axis freely; no tripod compositions.
shot_tips: Handheld for every shot, including dialogue
Never add lights or correct mixed colour
Ignore the 180-degree rule if it gets you closer to the truth

notes: Grain here reads as video noise (no SD-video stock id; digital_clean + dv_camcorder is closest).

label: Storybook Symmetry
summary: Whimsical dollhouse tableau: dead-centre symmetry, pastel production design and crisp flat staging.

craft.lighting: Soft even top light, no harsh shadows; colour-coordinated sets and costumes do the work.
craft.camera_movement: Precise lateral dollies, whip pans between set-ups, 90-degree pans; snap zooms for punctuation.
craft.framing: Centred one-point compositions, planimetric frontal staging, characters facing camera.
shot_tips: Centre the subject and build the set symmetrically around them
Move the camera only in straight lines and right-angle pans
Pick one colour family per location and dress everything to it

notes: No dedicated movement id; built from 'planimetric_deadpan' technique + comedy.deadpan. 'one_point_symmetry' is the alternate technique.

label: 70s New Hollywood
summary: Gritty, warm, grainy realism: zoom lenses, underexposed interiors and brown-and-amber city streets.

craft.lighting: Naturalistic underexposure, top light that leaves eyes in shadow, sodium streets at night.
craft.camera_movement: Sticks with slow zooms; handheld on location; car-mount driving shots.
craft.framing: Long-lens compression on city streets; unglamorous mediums; characters lost in the frame.
shot_tips: Use slow zooms instead of dolly moves to find the subject
Underexpose interiors and let eyes fall into shadow
Shoot on real streets with a long lens from across the road

notes: Genre set to crime as the movement's core; clear it for non-crime stories.

label: Music Video / Commercial Gloss
summary: Glossy, punchy, high-production polish: saturated colour, specular highlights and bold movement.

craft.lighting: Bold coloured backlight, specular edges, hard reflective surfaces, LED and haze; skin beauty-lit.
craft.camera_movement: Gimbal and crane moves, speed ramps, robotic arm for product beats; everything moves.
craft.framing: Hero centred, wide lenses close for performance energy, macro inserts on product or detail.
shot_tips: Cut on the beat and let every move land on a downbeat
Light with colour from behind and keep a beauty key on the face
Shoot at high frame rate so you can ramp speed in the edit

notes: References are music videos / an ad campaign rather than feature films. For a pure ad use genre 'commercial' with commercial.product.

label: Korean Thriller
summary: Rain-soaked, cold and bloody: precise compositions that swing between deadpan and frenzy.

craft.lighting: Night rain backlight, sodium streetlight vs cold fluorescent; overcast muddy daylight.
craft.camera_movement: Mix of locked-off deadpan frames and frantic handheld; long lateral tracking for fights.
craft.framing: Formal compositions broken by violence; high angles on victims.
shot_tips: Shoot it in the rain at night with hard backlight
Play a single long lateral take for a corridor fight
Cut abruptly from deadpan humour to brutality

label: Nordic Noir
summary: Grey, quiet, wintry dread: slate skies, flat light and one warm lamp in a cold room.

craft.lighting: Overcast flat daylight, cool low-key interiors, a single warm practical lamp.
craft.camera_movement: Patient static frames, slow dollies, drone shots over bleak landscapes.
craft.framing: Characters small in empty landscapes; tight faces in muted interiors.
shot_tips: Shoot exteriors in overcast; avoid sun
Keep one warm practical in every cool interior
Use drone wides to isolate a car on an empty road

references: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo (2009)
notes: References are mostly TV series, the form's main home.

label: Hong Kong Mood Cinema
summary: Smeared neon longing: step-printed motion, saturated colour and lonely figures in crowded cities.

craft.lighting: Neon and fluorescent practicals, coloured gels, deep night with blown signage.
craft.camera_movement: Handheld step-printed smears, wide-angle close to the actor, sudden freeze moments.
craft.framing: Wide lenses tight on faces, off-kilter, crowds streaming past a still figure.
shot_tips: Shoot at a low frame rate with a slow shutter and step-print to smear the crowd
Keep the main figure still while the world blurs around them
Use extreme wide-angle lenses close to faces

notes: Movement id hong_kong_second_wave (kb points at technique.step_print_smear).
